name: margie-desktop
description: MARGIE as a native macOS application: run analyses on this computer or on your HPC cluster.

scripts.dist: npm run stage && npm run icon && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:arm64: npm run stage && npm run icon && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:x64: npm run stage && npm run icon && electron-builder --mac --x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run stage && npm run icon && electron-builder --win
scripts.pack: npm run stage && npm run icon && electron-builder --mac --dir
